# bookmarker

> bookmarker is a free bookmark manager for iPhone and the web that collects
> everything you save on Instagram, X (Twitter), TikTok, YouTube and the open
> web into one library, files every save into a topic and subtopic
> automatically, and lets you search it again later. It is for people who save
> hundreds or thousands of posts across several apps and can never find any of
> them again. A saved item is called a "bork".

Home: https://bookmarker.lol/
Made by: Jean-Paul Wilson (JP) — hello@bookmarker.lol
Last updated: 2026-11-06 (iPhone app version 1.3)

## What it is

- A native iPhone app (iOS 17.0 or later), free on the App Store as
  "Bookmarker: Save Links & Reels":
  https://apps.apple.com/us/app/bookmarker-save-links-reels/id6799805479
- Plus a web app at https://bookmarker.lol/ that runs in any modern browser
  once you have signed in. There is no Android app and no browser extension.

## What it does

- Save any link from any iPhone app through the iOS share sheet, by pasting a
  link, or by importing a file.
- Files every save into one of 50 topics and 612 subtopics, plus topics and
  subtopics you add. The save always happens first; filing never holds it up.
- Quick File: straight after a save (share sheet, the + button, a pasted link,
  or the web app's Add dialog) a dial shows the seven likeliest topics with the
  best guess in the middle. One tap files it there; leave it and the save is
  filed under the guess, marked as a guess. Subtopics are one more tap.
- How the guess is made: on the device, a keyword ranking over the link and the
  title or caption, plus where you have filed that creator or website before.
  It is instant and works offline and signed out. Signed in, every save you make
  by hand is also sent once to bookmarker's own server, which asks an AI model
  to read the link, title or caption, account, hashtags and
  your tags and suggest a topic and subtopic, within a daily allowance. Its
  answer is weighed with the rest rather than overriding it; low-confidence
  answers are dropped. Imported saves are only sent when the on-device pass is
  unsure, a few at a time. Notes are never sent.
- Sort your borks: anything unfiled, and any guess worth a second look, waits
  in a deck, one card at a time, one tap each.
- Browse by topic or by the app a save came from; each axis filters the other.
- Search the title, the account that posted it, your tags, your notes, the
  topic and subtopic, the source app, the link, and whatever post text came
  with the save — a TikTok caption or X post text, the description a page
  published, or the full post body when the save arrived in an X data export. Searches can be narrowed to topics,
  subtopics or tags.
- Dated notes on any save, and a count of how often you have reopened it.
- Import browser bookmarks and the data exports from Instagram (saved posts
  and collections), TikTok (favourites and likes), X (bookmarks and likes) and
  YouTube (Google Takeout playlists, including Watch later). The web app also
  imports Pinterest and takes the export .zip as it arrives.
- Turn a set of saves into a public page at bookmarker.lol/c/<slug> with an
  expiry of never, one day or ten days, switchable off at any time. Whoever
  opens it can save the whole set into their own library.
- Side quests (group saves around a goal) and Revisit (what to look at again,
  including everything saved more than a week ago and never opened).
- The web app at https://bookmarker.lol/ works like the iPhone app: the same
  library, the same filing dial, import, and keyboard shortcuts. Signed out,
  you can look around a sample library.
- Library Island (https://bookmarker.lol/palace/) renders a library as a 3D
  island, one zone per topic.

## What it deliberately does not do

- It stores links, not copies. Opening a save sends you to the original post.
  If the original is deleted, the link dies with it — bookmarker is not an
  archive.
- It never fetches the page behind the link, so search does not cover the
  body of an article, a PDF or a video transcript. It searches only the text
  it holds. There is no quoted-phrase or operator syntax in search.
- Thumbnails and titles only arrive where the platform publishes them. YouTube
  and most ordinary web pages do. TikTok and X publish the caption or post text
  through embed endpoints that the iPhone app reads (TikTok with a cover image,
  X usually without). Instagram usually returns nothing to a request that is
  not logged in, so Instagram saves often have a plain title and no image.
- No Android app, no browser extension, no desktop app.

## Price

Free. The first 20 saves need no account; past 20, signing up is also free (an
email address and a six-digit code) and makes the library unlimited, backed up
and readable on the web. There is no paid tier in the app and nothing in it
costs money. A one-time founding-member price of $109 is being reserved at
https://bookmarker.lol/lifetime for a future paid version; payments are not
switched on and no card is taken.

## Privacy

The iPhone app asks for zero permissions and ships with no ad or analytics
SDKs; the library lives on the device and works offline. The website uses
PostHog for product analytics with inputs masked, which the privacy policy
discloses. Saves are private unless you deliberately share a collection.
